title: Akron Xtra Power Super Thin Turbo Diamond Cutting Blade, 4 Inch (110mm), for Stone, Tile, Brick, Ceramic, Set of 10
description: Akron Xtra Power Super Thin Turbo Diamond Cutting Blade, 4 Inch (110mm), for Stone, Tile, Brick, Ceramic, Set of 10 - Distributed/Packaged by Akron. Product Details: The Akron Xtra Power Super Thin Turbo Diamond Cutting Blade is engineered for professionals and DIY enthusiasts who demand high-performance cutting tools. This 4-inch (110mm) diamond blade delivers extreme speed, extreme sharpness, and extreme precision, making it ideal for cutting through tough materials like microcrystalline stone, tiles, bricks, and ceramics. The super thin turbo design ensures clean, accurate cuts whilst minimising material waste and reducing cutting time. With a maximum rated speed of 15,000 RPM, this blade maintains consistent performance even during demanding applications. The turbo rim design enhances cooling and debris removal, extending the blade's lifespan and maintaining cutting efficiency. This set of 10 blades provides exceptional value, ensuring you have reliable cutting power for multiple projects. Whether you're a professional tradesperson working on construction sites or a home improvement enthusiast tackling renovation projects, these diamond blades deliver the durability and precision you need. The blade's construction allows for smooth operation with minimal vibration, providing better control and cleaner finishes on your workpieces.
